title: weathered bundle note — before thursday lunch

title: A second set list
body: The singer stopped to tell the crowd where the exit was. A marshal took the microphone and pointed in the other direction, toward the closed service lane. The next morning the printed directions still showed the first exit.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
